SELECT child.relname FROM pg_inherits i JOIN pg_class parent ON parent.oid = i.inhparent AND parent.relname = 'operation_audit_log' JOIN pg_class child ON child.oid = i.inhrelid WHERE child.relkind = 'r' AND child.relname ~ '^p[0-9]{8}$' AND child.relname < 'p' || to_char(to_date(#{beforeDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMMDD')
